title: Sumerian accounts of civilizations from before the moon

tellings.quote: civilizations pre-moon that talk about they talk about you know the moon not existing and then there you know Sumerians talk about the premoon civilizations

plain: The ancient Sumerians are said to have told of civilizations that lived before the moon existed. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, while talking with a researcher named Randall Carlson about the idea that the moon is an alien craft. If so, people would have remembered a time when there was no moon in the sky.
